cases.candidate_question: The Taylor polynomial agrees with f at every evaluation point without a remainder.
cases.why_invalid: For f(x)=x^(n+1), center zero and b>0, the degree-n Taylor polynomial is zero at b while f(b)>0.

cases.candidate_question: A bound on f^(n+1) only at the center suffices for the same uniform error estimate with c=0.
cases.why_invalid: For f(x)=x^(n+2) centered at zero, this derivative vanishes at zero but the Taylor error at any b>0 is positive.

cases.candidate_question: Every smooth function is exactly equal to each of its finite Taylor truncations.
cases.why_invalid: The parameterized monomial of degree n+1 has zero degree-n Taylor polynomial at zero but positive value at b>0.

cases.candidate_question: If real series terms tend to zero, the series must converge.
cases.why_invalid: For any c≠0 the harmonic-scale family c/n has zero term limit and divergent series.

cases.candidate_question: The remainder bound c*q^n remains valid after omitting division by 1-q.
cases.why_invalid: For u(n)=c*q^n with c>0 and 0<q<1, the actual tail is c*q^n/(1-q), strictly larger than c*q^n.

cases.candidate_question: Convergence at a implies unconditional summability at every b with |b|≤|a|.
cases.why_invalid: At a=1 the alternating harmonic coefficients converge in ordered partial sums but are not absolutely summable; equality b=a already invalidates the unconditional conclusion.

cases.candidate_question: The weighted geometric sum equals 1/(1-q)² for Σ n*q^n.
cases.why_invalid: At q=0 all terms n*q^n are zero, whereas the proposed sum is 1; the required numerator is q.

cases.candidate_question: The geometric power series converges for |q|≤1, including both endpoints.
cases.why_invalid: At q=1 its terms are all 1; at q=-1 they alternate ±1 and do not even tend to zero.

cases.candidate_question: The derivative formula extends to q=1 by totalizing the rational expression.
cases.why_invalid: For x<1 approaching 1, the geometric sum 1/(1-x) diverges; at x=1 the totalized nonsummable tsum is zero, so it is not even continuous there.
